root_cause.text: The `bcmgenet_put_txcb` function calculated the returned transmit control block (`tx_cb`) pointer using the current `ring->write_ptr` before decrementing (rewinding) it, resulting in an off-by-one error that returned the next open control block instead of the one being cleaned up.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the calculation of `tx_cb_ptr` (`tx_cb_ptr += ring->write_ptr - ring->cb_ptr`) was moved from before the `ring->write_ptr` decrement/rewind logic to after it, ensuring the pointer is decremented first as described in the commit message: "we must rewind the pointer first then return the tx_cb that it points to."

bic_trace_step.reason: The function `bcmgenet_put_txcb` introduced in this commit calculates the returned `tx_cb_ptr` using the current `ring->write_ptr` (lines 1209-1210) before it decrements (rewinds) `ring->write_ptr` (lines 1213-1216). Author: Florian Fainelli <f.fainelli@gmail.com>

    net: bcmgenet: add main driver file
    
    This patch adds the BCMGENET main driver file which supports the

    - support for reading the UniMAC MIB counters statistics
